problem: Given that $P(A)=0.4,$ $P(B)=0.3,$ and $P(A\cap B)=0.1,$ find $P({A}^{′}\cup B).$
worked_solution:
First, we calculate $P(A\cup B)$ using the addition law:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(A\cup B) & =P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B) \\  & =0.4+0.3-0.1 \\  & =0.6\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we construct the corresponding Venn diagram and shade the region ${A}^{′}\cup B.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14041480/assets/e3fecd795207853d1a17a3e23c0d2872a59fde1c0561b8e357aae4a1705ca651.png)

Finally, we have

$$
P({A}^{′}\cup B)=0.1+0.2+0.4=0.7.
$$
